description: Write a comprehensive root-level README.md explaining the architecture, project structure, API endpoints, and deployment instructions.
steps: Overwrite README.md with full documentation including:
- Architecture overview: two Lambda-backed microservices behind API Gateway HTTP APIs, each with its own DynamoDB table
- ASCII or text diagram of the architecture
- Users service API endpoints table (method, path, description)
- Tasks service API endpoints table (method, path, description, notes on userId filter)
- Prerequisites section: Node.js 18+, AWS CLI configured, AWS CDK v2 installed
- Deployment steps: npm install in each service dir and infra dir, cd infra && cdk bootstrap && cdk deploy
- Environment variables section explaining USERS_TABLE and TASKS_TABLE are set automatically by CDK
- Local development note: services can be run locally with express but DynamoDB must be mocked or use DynamoDB Local
acceptance_criteria: README.md lists all API endpoints for both services
verification: Read README.md and confirm all sections are present and complete
